answer: The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in meadow, expire in ember, and relic lists each expiry. Someone running 132 aliases therefore needs 24 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4444 identities would post 3935 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
